description: Create minimal design system in static/css/minimal.css with clean aesthetic: 2-color palette (primary #2563EB blue, neutral #64748B slate), single sans-serif font (Inter), generous whitespace (1.5-2rem spacing), flat design with subtle 1px borders, remove all gradients/glassmorphism/animations/orbs, unified minimal button/form/card styles, mobile-first responsive grid
steps: Create static/css/minimal.css with minimal design tokens: --color-primary: #2563EB (blue), --color-text: #0F172A (slate-900), --color-muted: #64748B (slate-500), --color-bg: #F8FAFC (slate-50), --color-surface: #FFFFFF, --color-border: #E2E8F0 (slate-200), --spacing-xs: 0.5rem, --spacing-sm: 1rem, --spacing-md: 1.5rem, --spacing-lg: 2rem, --spacing-xl: 3rem, --radius: 8px, --font-sans: 'Inter', system-ui, sans-serif

Define minimal component styles in minimal.css: .btn-minimal (flat design, 1px border, no shadows, hover: subtle background change), .card-minimal (white background, 1px border, 8px radius, 1.5rem padding, no shadows), .form-input-minimal (1px border, 8px radius, clean focus state with primary color border only), .alert-minimal (flat colored backgrounds, no icons, simple text)

Add responsive grid utilities: .container-minimal (max-width: 1200px, padding: 2rem, margin: 0 auto), .grid-minimal-2, .grid-minimal-3, .grid-minimal-4 with mobile breakpoints collapsing to single column

Remove all CSS animations, transitions, gradients, box-shadows (except focus states), backdrop-filters, glassmorphism effects, animated orbs, pulse animations, gradient text, and complex hover effects
Preserve base.html structure but simplify sidebar: remove gradient brand icon, remove sidebar collapse animation, flat navigation with simple hover states, remove user avatar gradients
Update base.html <head> to load minimal.css instead of app.css: <link rel='stylesheet' href='{% static "css/minimal.css" %}'>
acceptance_criteria: minimal.css exists with complete minimal design system (colors, spacing, typography, components)
All visual complexity removed: no gradients, no shadows (except :focus), no animations, no glassmorphism
Color palette limited to 2 colors: primary blue (#2563EB) and neutral slate shades
Typography unified to single sans-serif font family (Inter)
Component styles are flat, clean, and consistent across buttons, forms, cards, alerts
verification: Inspect static/css/minimal.css → confirm design tokens defined, no gradients/animations in any rule
Run python manage.py runserver and visit any page → verify minimal.css loads, no 404 errors in browser console
